Yes, exactly. From your link:

>The minimum drinking age is a state law, and most states still permit "underage" consumption of alcohol in some circumstances.

Edit: I am wrong about the guys drinking on base. They changed the rules.

Did you read the first two sentences? "The National Minimum Drinking Age Act of 1984 (23 U.S.C. § 158) was passed on July 17, 1984 by the United States Congress. Thus, not exactly. My point being, that while the drinking age remains technically under state control, it is actually controlled by the federal government by virtue of the purse.
So even if they pass the federal law the state would still need to pass another law to make it legal in the state. Thus drinking age is controlled by the state.
